sloka: गीतशब्देन सम्रुध्य लुब्धो मृगमिवावधीः ।अनार्य इति मामार्याः पुत्रविक्रायिकम् ध्रुवम् ॥२-१२-७८॥
transliteration: gītaśabdena samrudhya lubdho mṛgamivāvadhīḥ ।anārya iti māmāryāḥ putravikrāyikam dhruvam ॥2-12-78॥

translations.english: Respectable people on the highway will certainly say 'He sold away his son' and censure me as a mean person like a brahmin consuming liquor.
